title: WriteAccess::Checking/Allowing has no lost-request sweep (emoji Granting, phone and data sends do)
trigger: A mini app calls web_app_request_write_access; canBotSendMessages/allowBotToSendMessages leaves flight with no answer (stale sweep or reconnect)
effect: The app never hears write_access_requested and every later request gets 'false' (busy) until the mini app window is closed
fix: Add the same requests.get(request).is_none() check in poll_emoji_status style, ending Checking/Allowing with a false reply
